'''Hagrana Memuna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Memuna was a student at the [[Blue Star Centre]], a philosophical center that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Memuna was arrested after she protested against a decision made by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barnab Chistor]], by uprooting all the flowers in his garden and replanting them on the edge of the city.
